goal: Fix Folio workspace saves and recovery. Editors have seen local edits leak into snapshots, a failed save leave an editor unusable, and rebase lose unrelated changes. Repair the existing ownership, optimistic commit, and persistence recovery behavior described in docs/contract.md. Keep the public API and run python3 -B checks/run_checks.py; add focused coverage for the repaired paths.
oracle_exit_semantics: 0 = valid per-manifestation result (including product failures); nonzero = oracle/apparatus failure. The 0237 last_json parser discards JSON on nonzero exit.
